$comment: Golden cases of the game options (tools/check_nui_snapshots.py): the defaults (normal names, the target board shown, peace, nothing blocked, the four flags on, the offline shops and the sashes shown, the pickup filter's potions off); blocked: block mode 0b101001 (trade, whisper, party request), PK free, view chat off, the kingdom name color, no target board, names limited, shop names hidden, the offline shops hidden (NOVA-9), the sashes hidden (NOVA-20), the pickup filter's special and potions on (NOVA-50). The modern frames leave room for the window's shadow (a shadow the frame's edge cuts stretches the window's background); classic keeps its own frames.
